note: Assumption Parish (FIPS 22007) publishes its Land Development Ordinance as a PDF only; the parish site and the third-party guides say no interactive zoning map exists. Searches of ArcGIS Hub and Online found only parcels, boundaries, precincts and redistricting layers, no zoning district polygons. Towns (Pierre Part, Labadieville, Napoleonville) show no published zoning GIS either.
